facts.doc_title: Split of PRO-MEC-014 and Migration of Isolation Clauses to STD-ISO-006

setpoint.label: re-verification interval for a long-duration isolation

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility

response.body: The proving zero energy before intrusive work shall be provided and maintained for work covered by this change record. The re-verification interval for a long-duration isolation shall be set at 12 hours. This clause applies to activities archived under ISOLATION-OF-STORED-ENERGY at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility.
